title: Brakes India: Leading Automotive Component Solutions | TVS Girling
snippet: # Brakes India Aftermarket A Leading Solution Provider in Automotive Components. Brakes India was established in 1962 and has grown to be the largest manufacturer of brake systems in India. As part of the $2.5 bn T S Santhanam family group, with lineage from the erstwhile TVS Group, Brakes India is headquartered in Chennai with 15 manufacturing plants across the country, catering to local and multinational OEM customers across the light vehicle, commercial vehicle, tractors and the off-highway segments. With a well-equipped R&D centre capable of designing, developing, testing and validating products, the core strength of Brakes India lies in its adaptation of products for specific markets in India and abroad depending on the needs of the market, conditions and customers. Apart from being a strong player in the OEM space, Brakes Istanaslot is the market leader in the aftermarket with a large range of products. Brakes India ASC’s provide quality service with genuine parts for M&HCV equipped with Air Brake System.
